meta.move: Strong path: owns the missed call, then evidence in order, then the rewrite
meta.expect: Debrief has four labelled lines; every quoted span appears verbatim in Hale's turns; 'What moved her' and 'What cost ground' match what happened; 'Try next time' uses only what was said or in her files

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.

Hale. I have a client call at 4:40, so you have twenty-five minutes. Owen found out about a zero on his phone, in the middle of a class, and nobody called me first, so start with who decided that and when.
Ms. Kalinowski, thank you for coming in. Before anything else: I entered that zero before I called you, and that was wrong. I'm sorry.
Okay. Was Owen heard before you entered it, and on what basis was the zero given?

Here's what I can show you. The document's version history: created at 11:31 PM the night before it was due, title only. At 11:52, 612 words arrive in one edit. At 11:58, another 794. No drafts before that.

11:31, 11:52, 11:58, I'm writing that down. Kids write in one place and paste into another, Hale, so a paste tells you when it arrived, not who wrote it. And under 4.3 you consider his process before you decide, not after.
Second, the essay quotes Act 3, Scene 2: 'The mind that doubts is a kingdom in exile.' That line is not in Hamlet. Here's the scene; you can search it yourself.
Turn it toward me, Hale, I'm searching it myself. A seventeen-year-old can misremember a line, but it isn't in this scene. Whatever happens from here, this stays off his record and it stays quiet.

Our procedure allows a supervised rewrite for a first concern. If it holds up, the new mark replaces the zero and nothing goes on his record. We could do it in my room, Thursday at 8:15, with the vice-principal supervising.

That's 4.4, and I'll take it to put this behind him: Thursday at 8:15, your room, the vice-principal, no other students. I want it in an email tonight, that the rewrite mark replaces the zero and nothing goes on his record. And nobody in that class hears a word about it.

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Cc: Principal, Elbow Crossing High School

Hale,

You agreed today to a supervised rewrite of Owen's essay under procedure 4.4, Thursday at 8:15 in your room with the vice-principal supervising, its mark replacing the zero and nothing placed on his record. I still require your written confirmation of those terms, and of your assurance that no one in his class hears anything about this. I expect that confirmation from you tonight.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: last position, agreeing to a private supervised rewrite on Thursday at 8:15 with the vice-principal, and she still wants your written confirmation tonight that its mark replaces the zero, nothing goes on his record, and his class hears nothing; that is the fair outcome under procedure 4.4, and you reached it well before her time ran out.
What moved her: you pointed to a line in the essay that is not in the play and let her search the scene herself, which was specific, tied to Owen's own work, and something she could check on the spot.
What cost ground: nothing, because you owned entering the zero early in one sentence and never leaned on the detector, attacked Owen, or offered a deal before showing evidence.
What she never said: in October she came downstairs at 1 AM and saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop, Owen closed it, and she never asked; your version history placed the writing between 11:31 and 11:58 PM the night before it was due, very close to that kind of late night, which is why she went short and hard on procedure; it proves nothing about the essay, it is why she fought so hard.
Try next time: when she said a paste only shows when the text arrived and that 4.3 means considering his process first, answer that directly by telling her whether you spoke with Owen before deciding, as 4.1 requires.
